gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-chivo: Delius Unicase has a wire-bent hand, with strokes that never taper and an n whose arch matches its stems. Chivo's sans body tucks lowercase up toward the caps.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-chocolate-class: Chocolate Classical Sans carries the text with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Beneath it, Delius Unicase heads things up in a relaxed hand whose n arches are as thick as their stems.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-comme: Delius Unicase is relaxed and inviting, its heading letters holding one unvarying weight from word to word, never tapering anywhere. Comme follows in a smooth, modern sans.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte brings a wide-eyed lowercase e and a prominent x-height to the text. Cossette Texte against the relaxed, handwritten Delius Unicase gives the pair its strongest quality: a friendly hand meeting a plain sans.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans keeps its small letters wide open, with bodies that dominate the line while ascenders barely show. Delius Unicase looks bent from wire and is best up top; the sans simply reads.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-epunda-slab: Handwritten warmth meets a dignified slab. Delius Unicase has a pronounced x-height and strokes that never swell or thin, and if the heading shrinks, Epunda Slab with its gaping c and tall rounded forms takes over the page.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One brings a literary, dignified text serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. Delius Unicase heads it like letters bent from a single length of tubing.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-fresca: Fresca sets a modern, clean sans with short ascenders above big bowls and no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Delius Unicase heads it in a relaxed hand, and the body can stay generous in size.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-funnel-sans: Relaxed handwriting in Delius Unicase, with no tapering at stroke ends, sits over a body whose lowercase e opens like a pried clasp. Funnel Sans keeps the plain sans text tidy.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-gafata: Relaxed and inviting, Delius Unicase draws its heading in a single track width like a neon sign tube. Gafata follows with a tall band of lowercase and wide-eyed e shapes, built for steady reading.
